{{Quote|This next one goes out to the Mud-Jumpers of the 224th, slugging it out on Mimban. Keep your heads down and your seals tight, boys.|The host of the Grand Army of the Republic broadcast|audio=BettieBotVJ-Rookies.flac|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
The '''224th''' was a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict that began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Rookies date">{{TCWdates|105}}</ref> and was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Among the ranks of the 224th were [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] known as the [[Mud Jumpers/Legends|Mud Jumpers]].<ref name="Rookies" /> 

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Rookies date" /> the Mud Jumpers were involved in a [[Battle of Mimban/Legends|battle]]<ref name="Rookies" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Mimban DB">{{DB|location|mimban|Mimban}}</ref> [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].<ref name="Rookies" /> During the [[Ground warfare/Legends|battle]], the MudJumpers of the 224th received a shout-out from the [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bettie-Bot VJ|host]] of a [[Music/Legends|musical]] program on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic broadcast/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic broadcast]] channel. The shout-out which dedicated a song to the group, was heard by other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;[[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], [[Nub/Legends|Nub]], [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]] and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]]&mdash;stationed at a Republic [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] on a [[Rishi moon|moon]]<ref name="Rookies" /> of the planet<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="Rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 224th was first mentioned in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]],"<ref name="Rookies" /> the fifth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which was released on [[October 24]], [[2008]].<ref name="TCW EG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
